en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from some of our companions who said,

‘Muhammad Bin Hujr wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) complaining of Abdul Aziz Bin Dulf and Yazeed Bin Abdullah. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to him: ‘As for Abdul Aziz, So I shall suffice him<sup>asws</sup>, and as for Yazeed, so for you and for him there is a status in front of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So Abdul Aziz died and Yazeed killed Muhammad Bin Hujr’.
